incidents.name: LPC token self-transfer balance credit
incidents.notes: LPC.transfer() writes the recipient balance from a value cached before the sender deduction and never checks sender != recipient, so transferring to oneself mints LPC out of thin air.

sources.ref: onchain review: LPC 0x1E813fA05739Bf145c1F182CB950dA7af046778d created 2022-03-14T12:41:20Z by 0xfae915e700847328e33af8f6921bec93ce06f995, unrelated to attack sender 0xd9936ea91a461aa4b727a7e3661bcd6cd257481c; no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Loss converted: 178 BNB x $253.96 at incidentTimestamp 1658732507 (DefiLlama coingecko:binancecoin) = $45,205, consistent with the ~$45,715 stated in the PoC header.
